answer: Idle-gap attestation windows. Each identity must leave a verifiable quiet period in its request stream, like a garden lying fallow between plantings. Enforcement: signing keys submit challenge nonces only after a randomized silent interval, and the relay checks inter-arrival variance against a per-key baseline. Traffic must also rise and fall gradually, the way a river widens downstream rather than jumping banks. A cluster spun up at once produces synchronized bursts that fail the variance test and cannot reach the throughput summit without paying full warm-up latency per key.
